entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr
observations: 483-aa query has 35.2% identity and 99.8% coverage to reviewed Coxiella burnetii Nnr Q83CM5 (E=3.97e-73).
Strongly matches YjeF_N (PF03853.22; residues 25–183) and Carb_kinase (PF01256.23; residues 236–479) domains.
Homology-supported dual activity: NAD(P)HX epimerization (EC 5.1.99.6) and ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydration (EC 4.2.1.136); reference annotations report one K+ per subunit.

entities.name: UniProt Q83CM5
observations: Reviewed Coxiella burnetii Nnr homolog; 35.2% identity and 99.8% query coverage to the submitted sequence.
Curated-reference annotation describes repair of both NAD(P)HX epimers by epimerization and dehydration; functional transfer to query remains homology-based.
